newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian market vigorous after holiday week-end.
newsitem.headline: Estonian market vigorous after holiday week-end.

text.p: Estonian shares, prompted by good results and investor news, surged on Wednesday after the four-day midsummer weekend with the index rising in near-record trade, dealers said.
Total turnover was 110.7 million kroons, close to the record of 114.7 million kroons. The Talse index gained 2.08 percent to 273.30.
Construction company EMV, which made its main list debut, was the most active stock in trade of 40.4 million kroons to close 2.75 kroons higher at 70.50 kroons.
Hoiupank rose 5.25 kroons to 146 kroons in trade of 17.4 million kroons after it announced Sweden's Swedbank might become its strategic investor.
"As there is no final decision yet...the excitement with Hoiupank will continue," one dealer said.
Hansapank rose four kroons to 146 kroons in trade of 10.85 million kroons as the market responded to the release of its solid May results, dealers said.
Forekspank rose 3.6 kroons to close at 193.1 kroons in trade of 22.9 million kroons.
On the free market, privatisation voucher turnover was the highest at 3.8 million kroons.
